preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some Gator tokens to initiate transfer

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is that tokens sent to the burn address (0x000...dEaD) are not actually burned (total supply not reduced). Instead, they're transferred to the dead address where they remain in circulation. To demonstrate this, transfer tokens to the BURN_ADDRESS (0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD) and observe that the total supply doesn't decrease. The tokens remain in the dead address's balance but are effectively locked. This is a logic flaw where the contract incorrectly implements burning by transferring to a dead address instead of calling _burn() which would reduce total supply.
